# ghost/onelist

1List (F-Droid): a minimalist offline list app. Create lists, switch between them, add and remove items and read what is on a list. No account, nothing leaves the phone.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/onelist
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/onelist open_lists --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/onelist create_list --device <serial> --param name=<name>
ghost skill run ghost/onelist select_list --device <serial> --param name=<name>
ghost skill run ghost/onelist add_item --device <serial> --param item=<item>
ghost skill run ghost/onelist remove_item --device <serial> --param item=<item>
ghost skill run ghost/onelist get_items --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open_lists`: Open my 1List lists
- `create_list`: Create a list called Groceries
- `select_list`: Switch to the Groceries list
- `add_item`: Add Milk to the list
- `remove_item`: Remove Milk from the list
- `get_items`: What is on my list?
